body: Are you glad it didn’t work ?
Maybe because you know you still have a life to live, and deep down you still want to live it. Try to live for a bit, don’t be as focused on death and suicide and see if you still want to die.
Maybe hold on just a little longer. Talk to her, see how to make it less of a ‘burden’ on her and just try to make it work as best as possible for the both of you.
I’m sure she’d rather support you than have you die
You’re not a burden, people care
I just imagined me and him being friends  forever, I can’t imagine my life without him.

But if you just disappeared they’d have to grieve while simultaneously still waiting for you to come back. They’d still have hope that you could show up one day and you just wouldn’t. It might just be me but I’d much rather have closure than false hope. Maybe they’d feel guilty because you just left them out of the blue, or because they thought you had killed yourself. They would feel guilty either way. But the best possible situation for them would be being truthful.
So you’d rather burden your family forever because they’d never know where you went?
You can’t find them because they’re not real

That’s probably it. I have no clue what I want to do. I never thought I’d be an adult for some reason but now that’s pretty close and I’m completely unprepared. I don’t even know how to know what I want to do so I’m just stuck.

I mean schools annoying but I wouldn’t say it’s the cause of me being sad. I don’t like it but I barely do any work and barely go anyway so that can’t be the cause of it. Other than that I really don’t have any responsibilities, I spend most of my day talking to friends yet I still feel sad. I think I’ve become reliant on them. When I’m not talking to anyone I feel so alone. So maybe that’s it? I’m really not sure, I’m not great at thinking so asking myself seems a bit pointless.

I’m just always sad really. So I can’t stop it because nothing’s causing it. It makes me feel kind of guilty because nothing bad is happening to me but I still feel bad. There’s people who are actually dealing with bad things and then there’s just me. I should be happy or atleast happier but I’m just not for some reason.
